rows.ARS:
Medium yellow Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: Gold Dot
rows.Origin:
Bred by Simon (Simó) Dot (Spain, 1963).
Introduced in France by Pépinières Minier in 1964 as 'Gold Dot'.
rows.Bloom: Yellow. 22 to 25 petals. Large, double (17-25 petals), borne mostly solitary bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season. Long buds.
rows.Parentage:
Queen Elizabeth (Hybrid Tea, Lammerts before 1951) ×
Peace (hybrid tea, Meilland 1935)
